dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: Oh? Outsiders, are you? Hello there, greetings!

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm just a plain fisherman, barely scraping by...

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: But I feel blessed to be able to fish in a place as pristine as Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: If you like fishing too, I can recommend several good spots where you can catch tasty fish!
